page.overview:
What is Chogoris System?

The Chogoris System is an Imperial star system located at coordinates MX/46359//m/AE (Location: Stellar Grid 183-SPN/JN-32) in the Yasan Sector of the Ultima Segmentum near the Warp rift known as the Maelstrom.

The system is home to the White Scars Chapter homeworld of Chogoris, for which the system is named.

In 999.M41, Huron Blackheart, the Chaos Lord of the Red Corsairs Heretic Astartes warband, launched a massive invasion of the Yasan Sector out of the Maelstrom.

The bulk of the White Scars Chapter was deployed to other conflicts across the galaxy. The Chaos forces succeeded in occupying several systems within the sector and nearly overwhelming the White Scars garrison left on Chogoris itself.
